overall_reason: Most of the suite is kept, including every Raft safety contract. Each kept property was rechecked against the new source wherever the patch touches a watch location. Four entries change because the update changes behavior they encode: AutoLeaveAdvance, ProposalConfigurationDecisions, OutcomeSoundness and the UpdateAutoLeaveAdvance alias. The changes are edge-triggered auto-leave with pendingConfIndex bumped and no quota-retry branch; joint-aware conf-change admission; and zero-payload entries exempt from the size limit. The new behavior is backed by new tests: interaction testdata, TestUncommittedEntryLimit and TestRawNodeProposeAndConfChange. New properties cover leader-transfer abort on demotion, auto-leave commit and applicability, and the new probe of added peers, plus structural checks and reachability canaries. No requirement-level property is weakened. Several suspected implementation defects are recorded instead: an auto-leave that is missed or duplicated (raft.go:567), the admission/apply mismatch for empty non-Auto ConfChangeV2, and a 'Configuration changes are never refused' doc comment that the code contradicts. One candidate property is left unresolved.

shared_definitions.RewriteConsistent:
RewriteConsistent(o,R) == \A k\in DOMAIN o.entries:
    LET e==o.entries[k]
        blocked==o.pending>o.applied \/ PendingConfInLog(o) \/
                 \E j\in 1..(k-1): o.entries[j].kind\in ConfKinds /\ j\notin R
    IN IF e.kind\notin ConfKinds THEN k\notin R
       ELSE IF blocked THEN k\in R
       ELSE IF o.joint THEN (k\in R <=> ~LeaveReq(e))
       ELSE IF LeaveReq(e) THEN k\in R
       ELSE IF AmbigEmpty(e) THEN TRUE
       ELSE k\notin R
shared_definitions.Effective: Effective(o,R) == [k\in DOMAIN o.entries |-> IF k\in R THEN NoopEntry ELSE o.entries[k]]
shared_definitions.DecisionV03:
DecisionV03(role,member,transfer,quota,w,lead,noForward) ==
    IF role="Leader" THEN
        IF ~member THEN "DropRemoved"
        ELSE IF transfer#0 THEN "DropTransfer"
        ELSE IF quota>0 /\ w>0 /\ quota+w>MaxUncommitted THEN "DropQuota" ELSE "Accepted"
    ELSE IF role#"Follower" \/ lead=0 THEN "DropNoLeader"
    ELSE IF noForward THEN "DropForwardDisabled" ELSE "Forwarded"

suspected_defects.summary: Auto-leave is never initiated by a leader elected with applied index == lastIndex in an auto-leave joint config.
